title: Result warning
description: A warning on a successful query or write result (its warnings array, absent when empty): the call worked, but the result is probably not what the agent expects. RLS_HIDES_ROWS: row-level security hides every row of a table in the statement from the agent role, and the statement returned or changed 0 rows. See CONTRACT.md, Next steps.

table.description: The table the warning is about, schema-qualified.

personMessage.description: One plain line the agent shows the person verbatim.
